title: Spent 2 weeks and built a little game that was always on my mind.
author: Jaded-Temporary7986
selftext:
Built this game. Spent 2 weeks. But now my AI quota is exhausted so although not complete I deployed it.

It was a fun concept I always had, village sim where I create the village and then get to roam around that village as a player. Sounds super fun. And I did not know that reaching this level of graphics is possible for a browser game.

I am not a game dev and I'm not pretending to be a master coder, I just had a fun idea a tried it and created something beautiful.

Spent the last 1 week improving the logic systems, reality engine, self building village system, villagers with actual awareness. They remember what you do, gossip about it, vote for a mayor, and if the village is missing a hospital and nobody builds it, they pool their money and build it themselves. Also fixed the 3D models as previously I was using coded models, fixed the seasons, festivals.

I always liked the Rockfellar center Christmas tree tradition but I could never visit so I made my own Rockfellar center inspired Christmas logic in this game as well. Lol. A helicopter scouts for the tree, a crane cuts it down, it gets driven into town on a truck with a police escort, they put up the lights, and there’s a lighting ceremony on the night. There’s also New Year, Easter and Diwali. I just added whatever I liked and it did not turn out so bad. I’m happy.

You can drive, work jobs (firefighter, taxi, pilot, farmer and more), talk to villagers, get chased by the police, and take a train or plane to other cities.

As I'm over my AI quota and do not have more money to buy Claude anymore so decided to deploy it. It's not unplayable but it's not 100% polished, some things are janky, and it’s single player only. More like 60%. Villager chat runs on a free AI tier, so when it hits the limit they fall back to basic lines. If your graphics card runs out of memory it reloads with lighter graphics and your village is saved.

Attached a little gameplay. Just sharing as I'm a little happy today. Haha.
